title: TestFabricAddItemMod1
description: 1510ty's first FabricMod, which adds items and blocks
body:
# TestFabricAddItemMod1 ## Overview of this Mod A mod made by 1510ty that adds items and blocks. This mod was created as a trial by 1510ty, a Java beginner. Please don't expect too much. Versions prior to 3.1.1 are available on Github. However, most of them are not translated into English and there are no explanations for the mods, so I don't recommend them.
This mod was created using IntelliJ IDEA. Please note: 1510ty is Japanese, so some of the content of the mod may be in Japanese and some of the English may be translated, so you may feel uncomfortable. ## what is added ・TestItem1
・TestBlock1
In future updates, more items that are useful for building will be added. ## Test environment Minecraft 1.21.4 Fabric lorder 0.16.10 Fabric API 0.114.2 CPU: Intel Core i7 13620H
RAM: 32GB 5200MT/s
SSD: 512GB
GPU:Nvidia Geforce RTX 4060 laptop
## How to install 1. Download the mod file (.jar) for your version of Minecraft. 2. Download the FabricAPI that matches the version of Fabric loader. 3. Install Fabric loader 0.16.10 on Launcher 4. Move the downloaded Mod file and FabricAPI to the Mods folder in your profile. 5. Start!
We plan to add a video on how to install it at a later date.
If you install this mod and want to play multiplayer, you will need to install it on both the client and the server. ## others The source code is available on Github.
Development environment: IntelliJ IDEA ### About the creator 1510ty 1510ty on Scratch [https://scratch.mit.edu/users/1510ty/](https://scratch.mit.edu/users/1510ty/)
